newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Meiling announces 96 dividend details.
newsitem.headline: Meiling announces 96 dividend details.

text.p: Refrigerator producer Hefei Meiling Co Ltd on Tuesday said it would make a 1.31-for-10 bonus issue for B shareholders as a dividend for 1996.
For holders of domestic currency A shares, the company would make a 3.50-for-10 bonus issue, Meiling said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
The registration deadline for the bonus issue is June 23 and Meiling's A and B shares will go ex-dividend on June 24, the statement said.
Bonus B shares will be listed on June 27, and the bonus A shares on June 26, it said.

After the issue, Meiling will have a total of 380.23 million shares, composed of 175.22 million unlisted state and institutional shares, 113.10 million B shares and 91.91 million A shares, the statement said.
Meiling's net profit for 1996 was 138.3 million yuan, an increase of 45.47 percent from 95.1 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Meiling listed 100 million foreign currency B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange last August.
